_note: Governance tier: framework-neutral, published rule matrix. Order of evaluation: unsure defaults → severity modifiers → base matrix → escalators → floors. Prohibited systems get tier 'P' and no number. See docs/v2/classification-spec.md §6.

severity_modifiers.why: Material harm that cannot easily be detected and reversed is treated as serious.

escalators.why: Vulnerable people or children are affected.

floors.why: EU AI Act high-risk systems (including provisional classifications) need at least enhanced governance.

P.name: Prohibited
P.summary: Do not develop, place on the market or use. Escalate to Legal.

1.name: Basic
1.summary: Record it and name an owner.

2.name: Standard
2.summary: Lightweight, documented risk assessment and transparency.
expects: Basic performance monitoring and an issue route

3.name: Enhanced
3.summary: Formal impact assessment, designed oversight and pre-deployment testing.
expects: Pre-deployment testing for validity, robustness and bias

4.name: Critical
expects: Executive sign-off and named accountable executive
Continuous monitoring with thresholds and kill-switch
